column1: # Minigame currencies worth their alch value (owner 2026-11-03). They buy rewards in their own
#   shops, so unlike no_value.tsv items that value is real worth; the currency catalogue still
#   keeps platform item mappings and market quotes away from them. RuneLite's alch price is 60%
#   of the store value: abyssal pearls, stardust and unidentified minerals 50 -> 30, golden
# Other guarded currencies use their own alch value when no supported proxy quote exists.
